newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 29.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Village Roadshow Ltd said early on Tuesday it would spend A$170 million to buy 50 percent of Warner Brothers chain of cinemas in the United Kingdom and Germany. Warner Brothers, a unit of Time Warner, will hold the other 50 percent.
Standard Chartered Plc on Monday declined to comment on rumours that it would merge with Australia and New Zealand Banking Group.

Stockfeed producer Ridley Corp Ltd said on Monday it would not raise the takeover offer for maltster Joe White Maltings Ltd which closes on November 8. Ridley is offering cash A$5.44 per share, made up of A$5.30 a share plus 14 cents a share dividend.
Pall Corp said overnight in New York that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Gelman Sciences Inc, which it said had ended a merger pact with Memtec Ltd.

Takeover target Discovery Petroleum told shareholders on Monday no formal talks were underway with suitor Premier Oil Australia Pty Ltd over a higher offer although officials of both companies later acknowledged the companies have had some contact.

Westgold Resources NL said on Monday it had entered an agreement to acquire another 6.67 million shares in Bolnisi Gold NL, representing 4.9 percent of Bolnisi's capital, at 16 cents each. This takes its stake to 19.97 percent.

Diversified mining and engineering group Ticor Ltd said late on Monday it expected its profit for the full calendar 1996 year would be significantly worse than previously indicated because of delays in increasing synthetic rutile output and weak titanium dioxide pigment prices.
Casino operator said before the market opened that September quarter pre-tax profit was up 21 percent at A$14.7 million.
